global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp nori, and chopped green onions. Served in a patterned bowl with a white spoon, it rests on a dark tray under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Black tray with orange rim, smooth surface, rectangular shape, slightly reflective, edges visible.
regions.bowl: The bowl is white ceramic with a glossy orange rim featuring a repeating geometric pattern.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, green onions, and seaweed, golden-brown, glossy, and richly textured surface.
regions.spoon: A white plastic spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly tapered end, showing subtle gloss and faint yellow stain near handle.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed: dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, with visible surface ridges and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, slightly fatty slice with golden-brown sear, irregular shape, and visible marbling on surface.
